sentences.text: The holotype — the single specimen the species is based on — is a 41 mm long tail stinger with five longitudinal grooves, originally mistaken for a shark spine but now identified as belonging to a ray.
Miosynechodus mora was named in 1969 and is considered a dubious genus of an extinct ray from the Miocene of Sri Lanka.
Miosynechodus mora is the type species for the genus Miosynechodus, which belongs to the class Chondrichthyes.
The Paleobi Database lists Hybodontidae as the parent group, though the genus is now placed within the family Hybodontidae.
This genus lived during the Langhian stage, between 15.98 and 13.82 million years ago.
